description: Control for the mangling case, revised in round 7: with no class in the file nothing is mangled, and `__omit()` is the module's `from pytest import skip as __omit`; but an imported name that starts with `__` is never certain (it is mangled in any class, and Python binds names of that form on its own): TG003 warns that it may skip `test_adds`, never FAIL. The real runner skips the test.
